What's inside GO

Everything a gymnastics family actually needs.

Six pillars of expert-backed support, built for the realities of competitive gymnastics life — from the gym floor to the dinner table.

Strength & Conditioning

Purpose-designed workouts and programmes to improve performance across 12 key masterclass areas, all built to complement — never replace — club training. New workouts added every month.

Nutrition for Gymnasts

Dietitian-approved recipe books, expert interviews, and practical fuelling guidance built specifically for young gymnasts and their families.

Gymnastics Education

Skills, levels, judging basics, and what meaningful progress looks like — explained clearly for parents who want to understand the sport.

Gymnast Wellbeing

Confidence, mental strength, growth, and staying connected to the joy of the sport — practical guidance for every stage of the journey.

Parent Community

Connect with other gymnastics families. Discuss training, share experiences, ask questions, and never feel alone in the gym life chaos.

Expert Access

Exclusive live webinars with world-class coaches, sports psychologists, dietitians, physiotherapists, judges, athletes and other experts — ask your questions directly.

Real exercises.
Real problems solved.

Scroll through this small sample below and spot your child's challenge.

Every workout and exercise in GO targets a specific gap, building the physical and athletic foundations gymnasts need to thrive.

Strength Flexibility Stability Range of Motion Coordination Timing Speed Power Body Lines Artistry

These are the qualities your child’s coach is working to develop. GO gives gymnasts a consistent, structured way to build those foundations at home — so when they walk back through the gym doors, they are stronger, more prepared, and ready to progress faster.

Skills come from the coach. GO builds the athlete who is ready to learn them.

My child: can't get both legs up evenly in split jumps
Split Leaps & Jumps · Workout B
Pool Noodle Split Jump
The pool noodle gives instant feedback — both legs have to fire equally to clear it. Builds the hip flexor strength and leg coordination behind a clean, even split jump.
Split Leaps & Jumps Flexibility
My child: struggles to press to handstand or loses control on the way up
Handstands & Press · Workout A
Pike Wall Lean
Develops the shoulder compression, scapular strength and lat engagement needed to press to handstand — loading the exact position gymnasts fight to control at the top.
Handstands & Press Strength & Conditioning
My child: wobbles on beam and loses focus mid-skill
Beam Mastery · Workout D
Vision Training Balance
Trains the focus point and visual anchoring that stops beam wobble — teaching gymnasts to use their eyes as a stability tool, not just their feet.
Beam Mastery Vestibular & Neuroperformance
My child: loses shape on bars and can't hold positions under fatigue
Bars Strength & SC · Workout B
Mountain Climbers
High-tempo core and hip flexor conditioning that builds the functional strength gymnasts need to stay tight through every bar swing, cast and transition — even when tired.
Bars Strength & SC Power
My child: goes floppy through vault or loses shape off the springboard
Vault Run · Workout C
Cast Handstand on Swiss Ball
Builds the shoulder extension, core tension and overhead stability needed for a clean vault post — the body shape drilled here is exactly what's required off the springboard.
Vault Run Handstands & Press
My child: can't get toes to bar or is struggling with the kip
The Kip · Workout B
Tuck Slides
Develops the hip flexor compression and bar-swing timing needed for toes-to-bar and the kip — building the pulling strength and hollow body control that makes the skill click.
The Kip Bars Strength & SC
My child: lacks artistry and flow in her routines
Posture & Artistry · Workout C
Body Arch Sequence
Develops the back flexibility, body wave and expressive movement quality that separates technically correct from truly beautiful — artistry and flow built through structured repetition.
Posture & Artistry Flexibility
My child: wobbles on single leg work and beam balances
Beam Mastery · Workout A
Aeroplane Balance with Rotation
Builds the rotational stability and single-leg proprioception gymnasts need for every beam balance — the progressive challenge that makes wobbling on one leg a thing of the past.
Beam Mastery Injury Prevention

Why Trust Us?

Built on real expertise, real experience, and a genuine love for the sport.

Deep Expertise

Every programme is built by qualified gymnastics coaches, FIG-accredited judges, sports dietitians, and physiotherapists — not generic fitness content repackaged.

Lived Experience

Founded by a gym mum and former athlete, coach and judge. Guided by an Olympic gymnast, and shaped by families who understand the realities of competitive gymnastics life.

Safe & Evidence-Based

Every exercise, recipe, and resource is designed to complement club training — never replace it. All are approved by qualified experts, are age appropriate and specific to gymnastics.

Why GO exists

Real parents. Real challenges.

The struggles that inspired us to build Gymnastics Online.

"I watch my daughter train four times a week and I still don't understand the levels system or what she's working towards."

Parent of Level 4 gymnast

"She's always exhausted but I have no idea if she's eating the right things. Nobody at the club talks about nutrition."

Parent of a Level 8 gymnast

"I want to help at home but I'm never sure if what I'm doing is actually useful or just getting in the way."

"The mental side worries me more than anything. She puts so much pressure on herself and I don't know how to help."

Parent of Level 7 gymnast

The GO experts

Guidance you can actually trust.

Every piece of content on GO is created or approved by qualified gymnastics specialists — not generic fitness content dressed up for gymnastics.

Kym Volp
Founder
Former gymnast, qualified judge, and gym mum. Built GO to bridge the gap between clubs and families.

Kym Volp is the founder of Gymnastics Online and brings a lifetime of connection to the sport as a former gymnast, current gym mum, and qualified intermediate judge. Motivated by her own experiences within the gymnastics community, Kym created Gymnastics Online to support both athletes and their families with resources that are fun, safe, and effective.

She understands first-hand the joys and challenges of being part of a gymnastics family and is passionate about bridging the gap between coaches, clubs, and parents. Under her leadership, Gymnastics Online has collaborated with expert coaches, physiotherapists, and judges to ensure that every programme is grounded in professional knowledge while remaining accessible for young gymnasts at home.

Kym’s vision is to empower parents and gymnasts with the tools to build strength, confidence, and passion for the sport, while complementing the incredible work that happens in the gym.

Emma Nedov
Gymnast Mentor & High-Performance Advocate
Olympic gymnast, three-time World Championship representative, and certified performance nutritionist.

Emma Nedov trained elite artistic gymnastics for over twenty years and represented Australia for over a decade at three World Championships and multiple World Cup events including the Paris 2024 Olympic Games. Recognised as one of Australia’s most accomplished balance beam specialists, Emma earned the title of Australia’s “Beam Queen” following her World Cup gold medal in 2019.

Emma brings a wealth of lived experience at the highest level of performance and is a passionate advocate for supporting athletes in their pursuit of success. She is a certified performance nutritionist and coach, providing advice and mentorship for athletes looking to optimise their potential both in and out of sport.

Through her keynote public speaking ventures at a sporting and corporate level, Emma combines her personal journey with her expertise in wellness to deliver resources that empower high performance individuals.

Stacey Umeh
Technical Advisor
39+ years in WAG coaching across six countries. FIG Artistry Expert and founder of The Creative Movement Group.

Stacey Umeh is an internationally renowned Women’s Artistic Gymnastics coach and movement specialist with over 39 years of experience across Australia, Canada, China, Japan, Singapore and the United States. She has provided artistic preparation, choreography, and technical expertise to national teams and has coached and choreographed for Olympic and World Championship athletes.

Founder of The Creative Movement Group and creator of the Artistic Advantage platform, Stacey is recognised globally for her pioneering approach to artistry in sport. Her expertise has extended well beyond gymnastics, consulting for synchronised swimming, diving, figure skating, netball, and dance, as well as serving as a FIG Artistry Expert Lecturer.

Stacey holds a Bachelor of Arts in Kinesiology and Health Sciences and an Advanced Certificate in Sports Coaching from York University. Her dedication, enthusiasm, and proven track record make her one of the most respected leaders in the gymnastics community.

Crystal Yeo
Gymnastics Performance Coach & Mental Skills Specialist
Former elite gymnast and international coach. Specialist in athlete mindset, resilience, and high-performance development.

Crystal Yeo is a former elite gymnast and international gymnastics coach with deep expertise in athlete mindset, resilience, and high-performance development. Having trained and competed at the highest levels, Crystal understands first-hand what it takes to thrive in the sport — physically and mentally.

Her work with athletes focuses on bridging the gap between physical preparation and the mental demands of competitive gymnastics, helping gymnasts build the confidence and consistency they need to perform at their best.

At Gymnastics Online, Crystal contributes performance and mindset content to support gymnasts in developing the mental skills that underpin long-term success in the sport.

Rebecca Smith
Mental Performance Specialist
Founder of Complete Performance & PerformHappy. 20+ years helping gymnasts and families with fear blocks, confidence, and long-term wellbeing.

Rebecca Smith is a mental performance specialist who has helped thousands of gymnasts and their families navigate the psychological side of the sport — from fear blocks and competition nerves to confidence, motivation, and long-term wellbeing.

She holds a Master’s degree (M.A.) and has over 20 years of experience working with athletes in high-pressure environments. A former gymnast and coach herself, Rebecca combines lived experience with an evidence-based approach to mental performance coaching.

As the founder of Complete Performance and the creator of PerformHappy, Rebecca is known for turning complex sports psychology concepts into practical, easy-to-use strategies that actually work in the gym and at competitions. Through PerformHappy, she has built a global community supporting gymnasts, parents, and coaches around the world.

At Gymnastics Online, Rebecca provides high-level education around the mental side of performance — helping parents better understand what their athlete is going through and how to support them effectively. GO subscribers also gain access to selected PerformHappy resources as part of the platform.

For families looking for more personalised support, Rebecca and her team at Complete Performance offer one-on-one coaching and programs tailored to individual athletes.

Zoe Power
Accredited Sports Dietitian
Former elite gymnast and founder of The Power Project. Specialises in youth athlete nutrition.

Former elite gymnast and sports dietitian. Founder of The Power Project. Zoe specialises in youth athlete nutrition, helping young gymnasts fuel their training and recovery with evidence-based guidance tailored to the unique demands of the sport.

Ashleigh Mitchell
Accredited Practising Dietitian
Founder of Nourish Paediatrics. Specialises in paediatric nutrition with a background in gymnastics as both athlete and coach.

Ashleigh Mitchell is an Accredited Practising Dietitian and founder of Nourish Paediatrics, where she specialises in supporting children and adolescents with practical, evidence-based nutrition strategies. Her work focuses on helping families navigate real-world challenges around fuelling, growth, energy levels, and long-term health — without adding pressure or complexity.

With a background in gymnastics as both an athlete and coach, Ashleigh brings an added layer of understanding to the environments young gymnasts train in. She combines lived experience with clinical expertise to provide guidance that is both realistic and relevant for gymnastics families.

At Gymnastics Online, Ashleigh contributes to the development and review of nutrition content to ensure it is accurate, age-appropriate, and aligned with best practice.
